== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-sorryaboutthemess-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Sorry About The Mess]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Sorry About The Mess (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “weapons (at normal use of the Force).” becomes “weapons.”; “each weapon” is added after “add 1 to”; “as if it has maneuver” becomes “using defense value”; “Hit target is” becomes “Any 'hit' targets are”. These are the same words as [[Sorry About The Mess (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Sorry About The Mess” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
